name: sticky-mcp-server

tools.name: post_sticky
tools.description: Pin a note to the STICKY board so it survives this session. Use it for a decision you just made, a constraint you must not break, or where the work paused. The board keeps only the newest few active notes: older ones tumble to the archive on their own, so post freely and never worry about clutter.

content.description: the note itself, one thought, kept short

type.description: constraint = a permanent rule (goes to the pinned column) · decision = a choice made · state = where work paused

tools.name: read_active_stickies
tools.description: Read the board: the permanent pinned rules plus the active notes. The archive is never included, so this stays small. Call it at the start of a session to find out what was decided before you arrived.

instructions: A visual board for what must not be forgotten. Post decisions and constraints as you make them; read the board when you need to know what was already decided.
